name: medical-device-streaming
description: Real-time medical device data streaming platform demonstrating Snowflake High-Performance Snowpipe Streaming for ECG, EDA, and PPG biosignal data with live analytics using ASOF joins and flattened views.

requires_marketplace.name: Synthetic Healthcare Data - Clinical and Claims
requires_marketplace.note: Optional. Provides patient demographics for advanced analytics. The streaming platform works without it.

notes: Snowflake infrastructure is deployed via setup.sql. The optional Python streaming client (in app/) generates realistic biosignal data and requires local Python 3.11+, RSA key pair authentication, and an AWS-based Snowflake account with high-performance streaming preview enabled.
